summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Enhanced Secondary Market Bond Calculator feature. All 12 backend API tests passed. Frontend UI testing verified all calculator components display correctly with accurate calculations.

Backend: POST /api/bonds/{bond_id}/calculate-enhanced returns all required fields
Backend: Clean Price calculation (PV of future cashflows at Secondary IRR)
Backend: Accrued Interest calculation (proportional to days in period)
Backend: Dirty Price = Clean Price + Accrued Interest
Backend: Multiple units calculation (totals correctly multiplied)
Backend: Interest Period Details (last/next payment dates, days calculations)
Backend: Future Cashflows (remaining payments count and totals)
Backend: Secondary IRR matches bond's secondary_irr field
Backend: Rejects settlement date before bond start date (400)
Backend: Rejects settlement date after bond maturity (400)
Backend: Returns 404 for invalid bond ID
Backend: Rejects units exceeding available (400)
Frontend: Login flow works (PAN + Password, then PIN)

Frontend: Settlement date picker works and accepts date input
Frontend: Number of units input works
Frontend: Calculate Price button triggers calculation
Frontend: Clean Price displayed correctly (₹1,04,257.32)
Frontend: Accrued Interest displayed correctly (₹997.26)
Frontend: Dirty Price displayed correctly (₹1,05,254.58)

critical_code_review_comments: Enhanced calculator implementation is well-structured with proper validation
Accrued interest calculation uses proportional method: (days_since_last / days_in_period) × next_interest_amount
Clean price uses XNPV-like discounting with secondary_irr
All data-testid attributes are properly implemented for testing
seed_data_creation: Used existing test bond 'All Home Bharat Platform' with Secondary IRR 11.5%, Coupon Rate 14%, Face Value ₹100,000
context_for_next_testing_agent: Enhanced Secondary Market Bond Calculator is fully implemented and working. Key features: 1) API endpoint /api/bonds/{bond_id}/calculate-enhanced accepts settlement_date and units. 2) Returns Clean Price (PV of future cashflows), Accrued Interest (proportional to days), Dirty Price (Clean + Accrued), Premium/Discount from face value. 3) Frontend displays all results with proper formatting and data-testid attributes. 4) Test settlement date 2026-01-19 produces: Clean Price ~₹1,04,257, Accrued Interest ~₹997, Dirty Price ~₹1,05,254.
